entry_state: Option labels alone do not decide derecognition. Under the admitted continuing-involvement branch, asset less associated liability represents the retained call; recognising that call again would duplicate the same right.
exit_state: A written put caps the retained asset and a collar subtracts the full put value. Amortised-cost transfers need separate asset and liability yields; the common transfer does not justify one shared rate.
